objectives: Describe how Judah dealt with Tamar and what he confessed.
takeaways: Er was wicked and the Lord slew him; Onan refused to raise up seed to his brother, and the Lord slew him also.
The sin was refusing to raise up seed to his brother; that duty later became law.
A harlot was known by her attire, the attire of an harlot and subtil of heart.
Judah acknowledged the pledge: she hath been more righteous than I, because I gave her not to Shelah.
Tamar bare twins, Pharez and Zarah of the scarlet thread.
